d.en:
Use this item to name your pet. If you say its name before giving it a command, your pet will respond much better to your orders. 
Example: Lucky, sit! 
Only #cletters and numbers# can be used in names, and #conly 1 blank space is allowed in the text of the name.#
d.zh: 可以給寵物取名。與名字一起命令的話，寵物會更順從。例：寵物名字 坐
d.cw:
可以给宠物取名。与名字一起命令的话，宠物会更顺从.
（例）小狗 坐。

d.en: Mysterious water gathered from the deepest valleys of Ellinia. Use it to extend a living pet's active time, or bring it to Mar the fairy in Ellinia to restore a pet that has turned into a doll.
d.zh: 在魔法森林深處採的生命之水。用這個水可以讓寵物復活。
d.cw: 在魔法密林深处采的生命之水。用这个水可以让宠物复活。
